missing_features.description: Migrate existing employee records and current leave balances into the new System to ensure availability from day one of live operation.
missing_features.name: Data Migration
missing_features.reason: TOR requires complete employee records and leave balances to be available from the first day of live operation (ST-a9f40f94ca, page 3), but no data migration feature is present in the backlog.

notes: User administration, role-based access, audit trail, and notifications are covered in the backlog as required by the TOR.
The backlog includes integration with attendance devices and payroll system as specified in the TOR.
Employee documents upload and management is included, matching TOR requirements.
Management dashboards and standard reports are present, covering monitoring and tracking needs.
questions: What is the source system for existing employee records and leave balances to be migrated?
What is the expected volume of historical data to be migrated?
Are there any data quality or cleansing requirements for the migration?
